title: slaude environment definition

name.description: The environment's name. Must equal the file name (environments/<name>.yaml) and is the reference env:<name> an agent allows. Required. Example: team-sandbox

description.description: What the machine is for, shown to operators. At most 500 characters. Never put a secret here. Example: Shared build box for the platform team.

kind.description: The kind of machine. Only ssh is supported for a shared environment. Required.

shared.description: Must be true. A definition is a shared machine: anyone in a thread can steer it through the agent. Required.

trust.description: Must be "unlocked". Threads using a shared machine need no /1on1 lock. Required.

defaultDir.description: The directory a thread starts in. An absolute path or one starting with ~/. Required. Example: /srv/work

host.description: Host name of the machine, or an IP address. It is stored on the gateway and never shown in a thread. Required. Example: build-box.example.com

user.description: The account slaude logs in as. Required. Example: dev

port.description: The ssh port. Leave out for 22. Example: 22

hostKey.description: The machine's host key fingerprint, from `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub`. Required: there is no trust on first use for a shared machine. Example: SHA256:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

allowPrivateAddress.description: true lets host be a private, loopback or link-local address literal (a LAN box). The gateway's own outbound rules still apply when it connects. Leave out for false.

ssh.description: How to reach the machine. slaude generates the key pair; only the public key is ever shown. There is no key for a private key, password or token.

description: A shared environment: one ssh machine, declared once at environments/<name>.yaml and referred to by agents as env:<name>. Unknown keys are refused at every level.
